description: Four drum sample players with attenuverted CV on the levels and the speed, and a limiter on each output

params.text: Sets the level that slot plays at when its TRG fires with ACC low, 0 to 200%
Scales that slot's standard-level CV, -100% to +100%
Sets the level that slot plays at when its TRG fires with ACC high, 0 to 200%
Scales that slot's accent-level CV, -100% to +100%
Sets that slot's playback speed, 1% to 200%, and can be turned while the sample is playing
Scales that slot's speed CV, -100% to +100%
Switches choking on between that slot and the next, so a trigger here stops the next slot with a 1ms fade

inputs.text: A trigger here plays that slot's sample from the beginning
Shifts that slot's standard level, a tenth of its voltage scaled by the trimpot beside it and added to the knob
Held above 1V as that slot's TRG fires, the accent level is used for that hit instead of the standard level
Shifts that slot's accent level, a tenth of its voltage scaled by the trimpot beside it and added to the knob
Changes that slot's playback speed while it plays, a tenth of its voltage scaled by the trimpot beside it and added to the SPD knob

outputs.text: That slot's sample at the level the trigger fixed, plus any slot above it whose own output has no cable in it

notes: nothing plays until a sample is loaded: right-click the panel and pick a slot under Slots, or right-click a slot's own display area.
the small display above each slot shows the first characters of the loaded file's name.
menu: Clear ALL slots — empties all four slots
Select Samples Root — picks a folder, after which a Samples Browser submenu appears in each slot's own right-click menu
Interpolation: None, Linear 1, Linear 2, Hermite — chooses how samples are read between points, which matters when the file's sample rate differs from Rack's or the speed is not 100%
Anti-aliasing filter — adds two-times oversampling and a 20kHz lowpass before the output
Outs mode: Normalled, Solo, Unconnected on out #4 — chooses how a slot with no cable in its own output is handled: added to the next output, dropped, or added to output 4
Scrolling sample names — scrolls the file names across the small slot displays instead of cutting them short
Store Sample in Patch — saves the loaded samples inside the patch file, which can make it very large
